_readme: Verification gate required by the master brief (section 1). Every business fact carries a status: 'verified' (approved for publication by the client) or 'pending' (REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — must never appear on the live site as fact). Components read this file through lib/content.ts and must gate rendering on status === 'verified'. The single consolidated approval list lives in docs/APPROVALS.md.

publicBrandName.note: Working umbrella brand per brief. Full legal lockup (2-3 logotype options) still owed to client.

legalEntities.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — Platinum Installations Inc. / Platinum TNT LLC / Platinum Construction were provided as brief context but are NOT verified. Spelling, DBA, ownership and footer presentation must be confirmed by legal before publication.

founder.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — preferred spelling (Boruch/Baruch), title, bio and photo must be confirmed in a content interview.

phone.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — calls, SMS, business hours and routing must be verified before Call/Text actions go live.

email.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — no public email address was provided.

address.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — not provided. Decide: office address, service-area-only, or mailing address.

serviceArea.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — publish only boroughs/areas where the company is actually licensed and active. 'New York' used as the broadest safe label pending confirmation.

licensing.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — license/insurance numbers only from approved documents, displayed per legal requirements.

yearsOfExperience.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — no numbers may be used until proven.

projectCounts.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — no counters or stats may be shown without proof.

testimonials.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — only client-approved text with agreed attribution level.

awards.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — none provided; nothing may be claimed.

socialLinks.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — only active, owned profiles.

domain.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — ownership/availability check needed (incl. audit of platinumconstructionny.com). Do not purchase or transfer without explicit approval.

businessHours.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — needed for contact page and response-time promise.

responseSla.note: REQUIRES CLIENT APPROVAL — thank-you page promises a response window; confirm the real SLA.
